Type: brass sputnik rod chandelier
Use: statement light over a dining table or living area; dining room, living room
Style: mid-century modern, modern, minimalist
Materials: metal rods in brushed brass finish, exposed bulbs
Colors: warm brass, clear bulbs
Shape: crossing straight horizontal rods at staggered levels, six bare bulb sockets on rod ends, single downrod with round canopy, wide, linear and airy
Feel: graphic, warm, airy, sculptural
Goes with: walnut wood, white walls, black or green accents; mid-century or modern dining rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Metal Rod Ceiling Pendant Light Chandelier - 48.9" x 42.6" x 43. 1", Brass
product.description: Give your living space a bold modern look with this pendant light. A series of brass rods extend from the center in various directions. At the end of each rod is a unique light, and together they complete this fixture’s artistically industrial aesthetic. 48.9" x 42.6" x 43. 1" Brass metal The lamp body can be adjusted 180 degrees Type G, Bulb not included Professional installation recommended For indoor use only
